title: McTrader per-symbol sentiment file
description: One symbol's sentiment diagnostic, as written by McTrader's services/sentiment_dump.py and updated in place by the local curation worker. additionalProperties is false at all three levels, so a file that gains a field is a file that fails its own schema.

symbol.description: The ticker, and the stem of the filename.

company.description: The company name the search was made for.

generated_local.description: When this file was generated, in local time with an offset, e.g. '2026-10-18 23:59:14 +1100'.

generated_utc.description: The same moment in UTC, e.g. '2026-10-18T12:59:14Z'.

sentiment_score.description: The PRODUCTION reading (DeepSeek's search judgement). Lifted from scores[role=production].score. Null when the search formed no judgement. The curation worker never writes this field.

local_sentiment_score.description: The LOCAL reading, 1-10, or null while pending / no view.

local_sentiment_status.description: The local reading's outcome: 'pending', 'ok', 'no view', 'not requested', 'unavailable', 'truncated', 'skipped'.

local_attempted_utc.description: Optional. McTrader's own worker stamps its retry clock here; a file that carries it keeps it.

search_refreshed_utc.description: Optional. When the paid DeepSeek search last wrote this file, e.g. '2026-10-19T06:00:00Z'. The collector re-searches and replaces the article set when this is absent or 28 days old, so a file written before the field existed has no value here and is simply due. The curation worker never writes it.

scores.description: The two readings side by side. Exactly one entry has role 'production' and one 'local'.

label.description: Names the model that produced the reading, e.g. 'Local — qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s'.

basis.description: Where the reading came from: 'deepseek_search' / 'ibkr_news' for production, 'strata_local' for the local reading.

comparison.description: 'vs production: equal', 'vs production: +1', or 'vs production: not comparable'.

articles.description: What survived the curation trim, in the order the file already had them.

status.description: The search gate's verdict for this article, preserved as written: 'KEPT', 'QUALIFIED, NOT SENT', 'DROPPED — ...'.

published.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD', or 'undated' when the source gave no date.

snippet.description: Optional. Emitted by the current McTrader writer, absent from the 2026-10-18 corpus; preserved when present.
